title: DP746 Unemployment, Labour Market Institutions and Structural Change in Eastern Europe
title_zh: DP746 东欧的失业、劳动力市场制度与结构性变化
authors: Michael Burda, Eduardo Levy Yeyati, Raphael Auer, David Koepfer, Josef Sveda 等
official: 官方在线 1992-11-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper surveys the emerging labour markets of the transforming economies of Central and Eastern Europe. Pissarides's model of equilibrium unemployment highlights the dynamics of labour markets as an important factor in the transformation, and labour market institutions will determine the long-run unemployment rate. A brief survey of institutions reveals considerable cross-country variance. Using data from Czech and Slovak employment districts, a matching function is successfully estimated. The flow approach to labour markets holds normative implications for the optimal closure or restructuring of the public sector, which are derived. The optimal closure policy is a `mixed-bang' neither a `big-bang' nor benign neglect is optimal.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了中欧与东欧转型经济体中新兴劳动力市场的现状。皮萨里季斯的均衡失业模型揭示了劳动力市场动态作为转型关键因素的作用，而劳动力市场制度将决定长期失业率。对制度的简要考察显示出显著的跨国差异。基于捷克与斯洛伐克就业区的数据，成功估计了匹配函数。劳动力市场的流量分析法为公共部门的最优关闭或重组提供了规范性启示，并推导出相应结论。最优关闭政策是一种“混合冲击”——既非“大爆炸”式激进改革，亦非放任自流的良性忽视。

title: A DSGE Model of Downside Risk
title_zh: 下行风险的DSGE模型
authors: Luciano I. de Castro, Antonio F. Galvao, David Hong
official: 官方在线 2026-07-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper presents a new dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE)framework based on recursive quantile preferences (quantile certainty equivalent),in which household downside risk attitudes are a model primitive. In this economy,infinitely lived households maximize the discounted value of the stream offuture τ-quantile utilities for τ ∈ (0, 1) with standard consumption and disutility oflabor. The quantile parameter τ captures the households’ downside risk attitude,independent of the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. Representative firmsare price takers, and prices are determined endogenously. We establish centralproperties of the model, including: (i) existence and uniqueness of a fixed pointfor household value functions, (ii) envelope condition, and the quantile Euler equation.We define the quantile recursive competitive equilibrium and establish itsexistence and uniqueness. We also provide an algorithm and numerically computethe quantile DSGE procedure. Lastly, we employ nonlinear impulse responsefunctions and present empirical results for the varying one-time technology shockimpulse response functions for augmented MaCurdy and KPR utility functions.We find significant heterogeneity in downside risk attitudes with the potentialfor countercyclical labor responses for a shallow shock in an otherwise frictionlessenvironment. Rates of dissipation of the shock also vary with the configuration.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个基于递归分位数偏好（分位数确定性等价）的新型动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）框架，其中家庭的下行风险态度构成模型的基本要素。在该经济体中，无限期存续的家庭以标准消费和劳动负效用为条件，最大化未来τ分位数效用流（τ∈(0,1)）的折现值。分位数参数τ捕捉家庭的下行风险态度，且独立于跨期替代弹性。代表性企业为价格接受者，价格由内生决定。我们建立了模型的核心性质，包括：（i）家庭价值函数不动点的存在性与唯一性，（ii）包络条件，以及分位数欧拉方程。我们定义了分位数递归竞争均衡，并证明其存在性与唯一性。同时提供算法并对分位数DSGE程序进行数值计算。最后，我们采用非线性脉冲响应函数，针对增强型MaCurdy和KPR效用函数，呈现一次性技术冲击脉冲响应函数的实证结果。研究发现，在无摩擦环境中，浅层冲击下下行风险态度存在显著异质性，并可能引发反周期劳动响应。冲击的消散速率亦随参数配置而变化。

abstract: this paper, entrants offer (differentiated) 'added value', but consumers incur a switching cost if they buy from one of them. The incumbent's profit-maximising price may be well above the level of its costs. This is likely to be the case in the UK's energy industries, but competition may be able to replace regulation in telecommunications, where marginal costs are lower, demand elasticity higher, and entrants can give more 'added value'.
abstract_zh: 本文中，新进入者提供（差异化的）“附加值”，但消费者若从其中一家购买则需承担转换成本。在位企业的利润最大化价格可能远高于其成本水平。这种情况在英国能源行业很可能出现，但在电信行业，由于边际成本较低、需求弹性较高且新进入者能提供更多“附加值”，竞争或许能够取代监管。

title: Does a Food Waste Tax Work? Evidence from Quasi-Experiments in South Korea
title_zh: 食品浪费税有效吗？来自韩国准实验的证据
authors: Seunghoon Lee
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Globally, one-third of food is discarded, generating lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions comparable to those from road transport. Further, waste management is among the largest municipal budget items worldwide. Exploiting plausibly exogenous unit-based food waste tax expansions in South Korea, I find that the tax substantially reduces food waste by discouraging excessive grocery purchases. Households sustain food intake despite buying less, but at the cost of additional time spent on meal production. Nonpecuniary motivations appear central to the policy’s e!ectiveness, and the tax is likely welfare-improving because more e"cient food use not only reduces externalities but also offsets time costs.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内，三分之一的食物被丢弃，其产生的生命周期温室气体排放量与公路运输相当。此外，废弃物管理是全球市政预算中最大的支出项目之一。利用韩国基于单位计量的食品废弃物税扩大的准外生性变化，本研究发现该税种通过抑制过度购买行为显著减少了食品浪费。尽管家庭购买量减少，但食物摄入量得以维持，代价是增加了膳食制作的时间投入。非金钱动机对该政策的有效性至关重要，而该税种很可能提升社会福利，因为更高效的食物利用不仅减少了外部性，还抵消了时间成本。

title: Globalization, Capital Taxation, and Development: Evidence from a Macro-Historical Database
title_zh: 全球化、资本税与发展：基于宏观历史数据库的证据
authors: Bachas, Pierre, Fisher-Post, Matthew, Jensen, Anders, Zucman, Gabriel
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper builds and analyzes a new global macro-historical database of effective tax rates on capital and labor in 154 countries. We establish a new stylized fact: while effective capital tax rates fell in developed countries between 1965 and 2018, they rose in developing countries since 1990. Multiple research designs at the country, sector and firm-level suggest that trade openness contributed to this rise, by increasing the share of output produced in corporations and larger firms, where effective capital taxation is higher. In contrast to a common view, globalization appears in many countries to have supported governments’ ability to tax capital.
abstract_zh: 本文构建并分析了涵盖154个国家资本与劳动有效税率的新型全球宏观历史数据库。我们揭示了一个新的典型事实：1965年至2018年间，发达国家的有效资本税率呈下降趋势，而发展中国家自1990年以来却呈现上升态势。基于国家、行业和企业层面的多重研究设计表明，贸易开放通过提升公司制企业及大型企业的产出占比（这些企业的有效资本税率更高）推动了这一上升趋势。与普遍认知相反，全球化在许多国家反而增强了政府对资本征税的能力。

title: Pulp Friction: The Value of Quantity Contracts in Decentralized Markets
title_zh: 纸浆摩擦：分散市场中数量合约的价值
authors: Olivier Darmouni, Simon Essig Aberg, Juha Tolvanen
official: 官方在线 2026-07-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Firms in decentralized markets often trade using quantity contracts, agreements specifying quantity prior to the point of sale. These contracts are valuable because they provide quantity assurance, as trading frictions could prevent a buyer and seller from matching in the spot market. However, quantity contracts prevent sellers from optimally allocating production across buyers after market conditions realize. Using proprietary invoice data, we estimate a model of quantity contracts in the pulp and paper industry. The average value of a quantity contract is 10% of profits, but would be 55% larger if sellers could optimally allocate production after market conditions realize.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在分散市场中，企业常采用数量合同进行交易，即在销售前约定具体数量的协议。此类合同因能提供数量保障而具有价值——交易摩擦可能导致买卖双方在现货市场中无法匹配。然而，数量合同会阻碍卖方在市场条件实现后，将生产在买方之间进行最优配置。我们利用专有发票数据，对纸浆与造纸行业中的数量合同模型进行了估计。数量合同的平均价值相当于利润的10%，但若卖方能在市场条件实现后实现生产的最优配置，该价值将提升55%。

title: Party discipline, representation, and the condorcet jury theorem
title_zh: 党纪、代表性与孔多塞陪审团定理
authors: Yves Kläy, Marco Portmann, David Stadelmann
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract How does district magnitude affect the quality of political representation? The Condorcet Jury Theorem (CJT) predicts that majority decisions improve with group size when members vote independently and are more likely than not to be correct. We test whether this aggregation mechanism applies to political decisions by examining whether larger legislative delegations better reflect constituent preferences. Nominal district magnitude often overstates the number of independent decision-makers because of party discipline. We therefore introduce effective district magnitude as a measure that more accurately captures the number of independently voting politicians within a constituency. Using 263 Swiss referenda (1992–2024) matched to parliamentary decisions, we find that the probability that a majority of a district’s delegation aligns with the preferences of its constituents increases with (effective) district magnitude, consistent with the CJT. The CJT aggregation mechanism closely predicts delegation-constituency congruence only for effective, not nominal, district magnitude. Our results provide empirical evidence that the CJT applies to representative democracies. They also show how party discipline limits the advantages of larger districts.
abstract_zh: 摘要 选区规模如何影响政治代表质量？孔多塞陪审团定理（CJT）预测，当成员独立投票且正确概率超过一半时，多数决策质量随群体规模提升。本文通过考察较大立法代表团是否更能反映选民偏好，检验这一聚合机制是否适用于政治决策。由于政党纪律约束，名义选区规模往往高估独立决策者数量。为此，我们引入有效选区规模这一指标，更精确地衡量选区内独立投票的政治家数量。基于1992-2024年263项瑞士公投与议会决策的匹配数据，我们发现选区代表团多数意见与选民偏好一致的概率随（有效）选区规模增加而上升，这与CJT预测相符。CJT聚合机制仅对有效选区规模（而非名义选区规模）能精准预测代表团与选民的契合度。本研究为CJT适用于代议制民主提供了实证证据，同时揭示了政党纪律如何限制大选区优势。

title: Openness, Integration, and the International Monetary Order
title_zh: 开放、一体化与国际货币秩序
authors: Tarek Alexander Hassan, Thomas M. Mertens, Jingye Wang, Tony Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper develops a calibrated general-equilibrium model to study how different configurations of trade and financial policy reshape the hierarchy of global currencies—and the U.S. dollar's position at its anchor. Currency safety and anchor status arise endogenously from each economy's 'effective size'—the weight its domestic shocks carry in setting world prices. Tariffs reduce this effective size on the goods side; capital controls do the same on the financial side. A unifying result emerges: The economy that maintains the deepest integration with the global trading network retains the largest safety premium and gains anchor status. We use this framework to evaluate the effects of three policy levers for Europe that affect the effective size of the euro: internal harmonization and enlargement, trade openness, and capital-account openness. The stakes are large: In our model, shifts in currencies' safety can redirect global capital flows and alter sovereign borrowing costs by hundreds of billions of dollars annually.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个校准的一般均衡模型，用以研究贸易与金融政策的不同配置如何重塑全球货币的层级结构——以及美元在其中的锚定地位。货币的安全性与锚定地位内生于各经济体的“有效规模”——即其国内冲击在设定世界价格时所承载的权重。关税会降低商品侧的有效规模；资本管制则在金融侧产生相同效果。一个统一的结论由此显现：与全球贸易网络保持最深度融合的经济体，将保留最大的安全溢价并赢得锚定地位。我们运用这一框架评估了影响欧元有效规模的三种欧洲政策杠杆的效果：内部协调与扩张、贸易开放度以及资本账户开放度。其影响极为重大：在我们的模型中，货币安全性的变动能够重新引导全球资本流动，并每年改变主权借贷成本高达数千亿美元。

title: Central bank verbal communication in China’s FX market: a nonlinear coordination channel approach
title_zh: 中国外汇市场中的央行口头沟通：一种非线性协调渠道方法
authors: Xiaoping Li, Bin Tong, Haoyuan Chen, Jing Huang, Zheng Xi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the role of central bank verbal communication in China’s foreign exchange market, focusing on the coordination channel through which communication influences exchange rate dynamics and market expectations. We develop a heterogeneous agent model where fundamentalists’ confidence depends on exchange rate misalignment and central bank communication. The model indicates that verbal communication can strengthen market coordination and accelerate the exchange rate’s reversion towards its fundamental value. Empirically, we construct a novel index related to central bank verbal communication based on official statements and examine its effects using a Smooth Transition Regression GARCH (STR-GARCH) model. Our results show that PBOC verbal communication is associated with changes in exchange rate dynamics and volatility, consistent with the coordination mechanism. We conduct a series of robustness checks and address potential endogeneity concerns arising from the central bank’s reaction to market conditions. This study contributes to the literature on foreign exchange intervention and expectation management by providing new evidence on the role of verbal communication in a managed exchange rate regime.
abstract_zh: 本文研究中央银行口头沟通在中国外汇市场中的作用，重点关注沟通通过协调渠道影响汇率动态与市场预期的机制。我们构建了一个异质性主体模型，其中基本面交易者的信心取决于汇率失调程度与央行沟通。模型表明，口头沟通能够强化市场协调，加速汇率向基本面价值的回归。在实证层面，我们基于官方声明构建了央行口头沟通的新指数，并采用平滑转换回归GARCH（STR-GARCH）模型检验其影响。结果显示，中国人民银行的口头沟通与汇率动态及波动率变化存在关联，这与协调机制一致。我们进行了一系列稳健性检验，并处理了央行对市场状况反应可能引发的内生性问题。本研究通过提供管理浮动汇率制度下口头沟通作用的新证据，为外汇干预与预期管理领域的文献做出贡献。

title: Public Works That Provide Care Services : Enhancing Women's Economic Opportunities, Boosting Human Capital, and Building Skills for the Care Economy
title_zh: 提供照护服务的公共工程：增强女性经济机会、提升人力资本并培养照护经济技能
authors: Noy, Itay, Heinemann, Alessandra
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Women around the world face a heavier care burden than men, restricting their participation in the labor force. At the same time, the shortage of quality, accessible, and affordable care services undermines human development and well-being. Limited investment in early childhood care and education reduces children’s learning and future earnings potential. Similarly, inadequate elderly care undermines health, independence, and well-being among older adults. Investing in care is, therefore, important not only for closing gender gaps but also for boosting human capital outcomes. It also makes a compelling economic case for investment, given the care economy’s potential to drive growth and create jobs in the context of ongoing demographic shifts. This note discusses how public works programs (PWPs) may reduce care burden, increase the provision of care services for those in need, and build skills for the care economy. Drawing on examples of World Bank-supported PWPs that provide childcare, the note explores how such programs can be designed and implemented, and what potential benefits and challenges early evidence reveals.
abstract_zh: 全球女性承担的照护负担重于男性，这限制了她们的劳动力参与。与此同时，优质、可及且可负担的照护服务短缺，损害了人类发展与福祉。对幼儿照护与教育的投入不足，会降低儿童的学习能力及未来收入潜力；而老年照护的匮乏同样会损害老年人的健康、独立性与福祉。因此，投资照护不仅对缩小性别差距至关重要，还能提升人力资本成果。考虑到照护经济在人口结构持续变迁背景下推动增长与创造就业的潜力，这为投资提供了强有力的经济依据。本文探讨公共工程项目如何减轻照护负担、增加对有需求人群的照护服务供给，并为照护经济培养技能。通过分析世界银行支持的提供儿童照护服务的公共工程项目案例，本文探究此类项目的设计与实施方式，以及早期证据揭示的潜在收益与挑战。

authors: 陈韬, 汪鼎

title: Private equity for pension plans? Evaluating private equity performance from an investor’s perspective
title_zh: 养老金计划的私募股权投资？从投资者视角评估私募股权绩效
authors: Arthur G. Korteweg, Stavros Panageas, Anand Systla
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2024-11-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We evaluate private equity (PE) performance using investor-specific stochastic discount factors, and examine whether investors could benefit from changing their allocation to PE.Plans invest in PE funds with higher average risk-adjusted performance.This is mainly due to access to successful PE managers, not superior selection skill.Decomposing returns into risk-compensation and "alpha", we find that some plans obtain higher PE returns by taking more risk without earning higher, and in some cases earning lower, risk-adjusted returns, broadly consistent with agency problems within plans.
abstract_zh: 我们采用投资者特定的随机贴现因子评估私募股权（PE）业绩，并考察投资者是否能够通过调整PE配置获益。投资计划倾向于选择平均风险调整后业绩更高的PE基金，这主要得益于接触成功的PE管理人，而非卓越的筛选能力。通过将收益分解为风险补偿和“阿尔法”，我们发现部分投资计划通过承担更高风险获取更高PE收益，但并未获得更高（某些情况下甚至更低）的风险调整后收益，这与投资计划内部的代理问题基本一致。
